newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech c.bank adds zloty, forint to daily rate list.
newsitem.headline: Czech c.bank adds zloty, forint to daily rate list.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) said on Wednesday it would begin to list daily rates for the crown against the Polish zloty and Hungarian forint on January 29 to aid payments calculations.

"The measure is a reaction to the growth of demand of domestic and foreign commercial banks and their clients, mostly in the areas of account management and payment relations," the CNB said in a statement.
The new listings are not intended to affect foreign exchange trading.
The CNB trades only in marks and dollars, the two currencies which make up the central bank's basket against which it fixes the crown each day.

All other currency rates the CNB lists are calculated from the fixing against the mark/dollar basket but are only for reference in payment conversions, not for actual foreign exchange trading with the central bank.
